title: The Firebird and the Golden Feather

spreads.title: The Glowing Feather on the Trail

game.start: Uncover the glowing feather with Misha! Tap all four fallen oak leaves upon the mossy bank.
game.praise: Uncovered on the moss! The Firebird's golden feather blazes like a warm little lantern!

game.start: Pack for the quest! Match wheat to the sack, bread to the basket, and the flute to the pouch.
game.praise: All packed for adventure! Woven sack, saddle basket, and leather pouch hold every travel gift!

game.start: Cross the rushing woodland stream with Misha! Tap the three mossy stones in order from left to right.
game.praise: Hop, hop, hop! Misha leaps safely across all three mossy stream-stones!

game.start: Gather forest treats for the midnight feast! Tap all four red berry clusters beside the wiggling fern.
game.praise: Sweet autumn berries! Misha gathers all four red berry clusters beside the wiggling golden fern!

game.start: Set out the midnight feast! Match wheat to the bowl, berries to the tray, and bread to the mat.
game.praise: Every treat ready! Painted bowl, birch tray, and woven mat welcome the midnight guest!

spreads.title: The Secret of the Living Light

game.start: Play Misha's wooden flute to comfort the Firebird! Tap three times when the ring glows green.
game.praise: Three sweet golden notes! Soft flute music shimmers warmly across the quiet starry glade!

game.start: Share the Firebird's lantern light through the mist! Tap all four wooden trail-lanterns along the path.
game.praise: Bright through the mist! All four wooden trail-lanterns glow like warm little suns!

spreads.title: The Latch on the Gilded Cage

game.start: Help Tsar Boris unlatch the tall gilded cage! Tap the gilded cage three times when the ring glows green.
game.praise: Three bright golden clicks! Warm sparks shimmer across the gilded cage door, ready to swing open!

game.start: Catch the Firebird's falling lantern light! Tap all four palace lanterns along the low porch railings.
game.praise: Bright courtyard gold! All four carved palace lanterns shine across Tsar Boris's rosy courtyard!

game.start: Share the autumn feast! Match apples to the bowl, bread to the platter, and the teacup to the samovar.
game.praise: Joy for all! Sweet golden apples, warm honey bread, and fragrant tea fill the courtyard!
